blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reliable evaluation of image forgery localization (IFL) requires assessing models under diverse distribution changes, yet existing benchmarks often cover limited manipulation conditions or entangle multiple factors in cross-dataset evaluation. Consequently, aggregate performance provides an incomplete view of localization generalization. We introduce GIFTBench , a multi-axis benchmark of 115,013 manipulated images with pixel-level annotations spanning manipulation source, semantic target, editing operation, and composition complexity. GIFTBench supports axis-specific transfer analysis and evaluation on twelve external datasets. Its diagnostic studies reveal asymmetric cross-source transfer, recall-dominated failures, and heterogeneous degradation across semantic, operational, and compositional changes. Beyond diagnosis, the scale and diversity of GIFTBench provide a substantially broader training distribution than conventional IFL datasets. Training representative localizers on GIFTBench consistently improves their aggregate transfer to external datasets, showing that the benchmark serves not only as an evaluation tool but also as an effective training resource for cross-domain localization. Guided by the diagnostic findings, we further develop ForenScope , a detection and localization framework combining classification-adapted representations with multi-depth, multi-scale spatial features, learned layer fusion, and selective coarse-scale conditioning. Experiments show improved cross-dataset localization while retaining image-level detection capability. The GIFTBench dataset showcase page is available at https://giftbench-preview.doudoudouya337.chatgpt.site .
blocks.zh: 对图像伪造本地化(IFL)的可靠评价需要在不同的分布变化下评估模型,但现有的基准往往涵盖有限的操纵条件或在跨数据集评价中缠绕多个因素. 因此,总体业绩对本地化一般化提供了不完整的看法。 我们引入了GIFTBench, 多轴基准 115,013 被操纵的图像, 并带有像素级的说明, 覆盖了操纵源, 语义目标, 编辑操作, 和组成复杂度。 GIFTBench支持对十二个外部数据集进行针对轴的传输分析和评价. 它的诊断研究揭示了非对称的跨源转移、以召回为主的失败以及不同语义、操作和构成变化的不同降解。 除了诊断外,GIFTBench的规模和多样性提供了比传统的IFL数据集大得多的培训分布. 就GIFTBench培训具有代表性的本地化人员,不断改进其向外部数据集的总体传输,表明基准不仅作为评价工具,而且作为跨领域本地化的有效培训资源。 在诊断结论的指导下,我们进一步发展了ForenScope ——一个检测和本地化框架,将分类适应的表示法与多深度,多尺度的空间特征,学习的层聚,以及选择性粗度的调节相结合. 实验显示在保留图像水平检测能力的同时,跨数据集本地化得到了改进. GIFTBench数据集的展示页面见https://giftebench-preview.doudouya337.chatgpt.site.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Image manipulation tools have made it increasingly easy to alter image content while preserving a visually plausible appearance. A complete forensic system should therefore answer two complementary questions: whether an image is real or manipulated and where the manipulation occurs. The former corresponds to image-level manipulation detection, while the latter is typically formulated as image forgery localization (IFL), which predicts a pixel-level manipulation mask. Although recent methods achieve strong performance on established benchmarks, existing evaluation does not fully characterize how they generalize under diverse distribution changes beyond their training data. That distribution shift reduces performance is unsurprising; the more informative question is which change makes a trained localizer fail .
blocks.zh: 图像处理工具使得改变图像内容越来越容易,同时保持一种视似可信的外观。 因此,完整的法证系统应回答两个互补的问题:一个图像是真实的还是被操纵的,以及操纵在哪里发生的. 前者对应图像级的操纵探测,而后者则一般被配制成图像伪造本地化(IFL),它预言一个像素级的操纵面具. 虽然最近的方法在既定基准上取得了良好的业绩,但现有评价并未充分说明它们如何在培训数据以外的不同分布变化下加以概括。 这种分配的转变降低了业绩,这是不足为奇的;信息更加丰富的问题是,哪个变化使得训练有素的本地化者失败。

blocks.en: Existing datasets vary in image content, manipulation source, semantic target, editing operation, and composition ( Dong and others, 2013 ; Hsu and others, 2006 ; Wen et al., 2016 ; Guan et al., 2019 ; Novozamsky and others, 2020 ; Tralic et al., 2013 ) , but these factors are commonly entangled across datasets or only partially annotated within them. As Table 1 shows, many benchmarks already contain large collections of classical or AI-based edits and substantial manipulation diversity. The limitation is therefore not simply dataset scale, but how this diversity is represented and used. Without a shared factorized annotation space, cross-dataset evaluation can reveal that performance drops but provides limited evidence about which variation is associated with the failure. At the same time, a useful benchmark should provide sufficiently diverse and consistently annotated data to serve as a reusable training resource rather than only an analysis tool. We therefore argue for a benchmark that jointly represents multiple manipulation factors, supports axis-specific evaluation, and provides a broad training distribution for studying and improving cross-domain localization.
blocks.zh: 现有的数据集在图像内容,操纵源,语义目标,编辑操作,和组成(Dong等人, 2013年;Hsu等人,2006年;Wen等人,2016年;Guan等人,2019年;Novozamsky等人,2020年;Tralic等人,2013年),但这些因素通常缠绕在数据集之间,或者只是其中部分注释. 如表1所示,许多基准已经包含大量古典或基于AI的编辑集以及大量的操纵多样性. 因此,限制不仅仅是数据集尺度,而是如何体现和使用这种多样性。 没有共享的要素化注释空间,跨数据集评价可以揭示性能下降,但提供的证据有限,说明哪些变化与失败有关. 同时,一个有用的基准应提供足够多样和一贯附加说明的数据,作为可重复使用的培训资源,而不仅仅是一个分析工具。 因此,我们主张制定一个共同代表多种操纵因素的基准,支持针对轴线的评价,并为研究和改进跨域本地化提供广泛的培训分布。

blocks.en: To support both structured evaluation and diverse model training, we introduce GIFTBench , a multi-axis benchmark built from ADE20K with 115,013 manipulated images and pixel-level masks. Each sample is annotated by manipulation source, semantic target, editing operation, and composition complexity, covering diverse scenes together with both classical and AI-based manipulations. Rather than constructing separate datasets for individual factors, GIFTBench organizes these variations within a unified generation and annotation framework, yielding a coherent training distribution with diversity across multiple levels. The structured annotations enable axis-specific transfer analysis, while the complete training set can be used directly to train localization models. Generalization beyond the benchmark is further evaluated on twelve external datasets.
blocks.zh: 为了支持结构化的评价和多样化的模型培训,我们引入了GIFTBench ——一个由ADE20K构建的多轴基准,拥有115,013个被操纵的图像和像素级口罩. 每个样本都通过操控源,语义目标,编辑操作,和成分复杂度来注释,既包括古典和基于AI的操控,也涵盖各种场景. GIFTBench没有为个别因素建立单独的数据集,而是在统一的生成和注释框架内组织这些变化,从而在多个层次上形成协调一致的培训分布。 结构化的说明可以进行轴特定转移分析,而完整的训练集可以直接用于训练本地化模型. 在12个外部数据集上进一步评价超出基准的概论。

blocks.en: The axis-specific protocols reveal asymmetric cross-source transfer, recall-dominated failures, and heterogeneous degradation across semantic, operational, and compositional shifts. Beyond diagnosis, training representative localizers on the complete GIFTBench set improves aggregate transfer to external datasets over their reference training distributions, showing that its diversity benefits both generalization evaluation and transferable model learning.
blocks.zh: 轴特定协议揭示了不对称的交叉源转移、召回式失败以及不同语义、操作和组成变化的降解。 除了诊断外,对具有代表性的本地化者进行完整的GIFTBench集的培训,比其参考培训分布改进了向外部数据集的总体转移,表明其多样性既有利于一般化评价,也有利于可转让模型学习。

blocks.en: We develop ForenScope , a joint detection–localization framework built on a classification-adapted DINOv2 representation ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) . Its localization branch combines multi-depth patch features, learnable cross-layer fusion, bounded global-to-local modulation, and coarse-to-fine decoding; the design rationale and empirical tests are presented later.
blocks.zh: 我们开发了ForenScope,一个基于分类调整的DINov2表示的联合检测-本地化框架(Oquab等人,2024年)。 其本地化分支结合了多深度的补丁特征,可学习的跨层聚变,捆绑的全域对本地调制,以及粗细的对法解码;设计原理和经验测试在稍后提出.

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: • We introduce GIFTBench , a large-scale, multi-axis benchmark with diverse scenes and manipulations organized within a unified construction framework, supporting both structured generalization evaluation and model training. • We show that GIFTBench enables systematic diagnosis of localization generalization, revealing asymmetric cross-source transfer, recall-dominated failures, and heterogeneous semantic, operational, and compositional degradation. Training on the complete GIFTBench distribution also improves aggregate transfer across external datasets. • We develop and evaluate ForenScope , a detection and localization model that retains image-level detection while improving cross-dataset localization.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献有三: 我们引入了GIFTBench——一个大型多轴基准,在统一的建筑框架内组织各种场景和操纵,支持结构化的泛化评价和模式培训。 我们显示,GIFTBench能够系统诊断局部化的泛化,揭示不对称的交叉源转移,召回为主的失败,以及不同的语义、操作和组成退化。 • 全面全球信息、技术和电信数据库分布培训也改进了跨外部数据集的总体转移。 我们开发并评估ForenScope,一种检测和本地化模型,它保留图像级检测,同时改进跨数据集本地化.

Training on the complete GIFTBench distribution also improves aggregate transfer across external datasets.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Early IFL benchmarks focused on splicing, copy-move, and limited post-processing artifacts ( Dong and others, 2013 ; Hsu and others, 2006 ; Wen et al., 2016 ; Guan et al., 2019 ) . Later datasets broadened manipulation sources and included more realistic in-the-wild images ( Novozamsky and others, 2020 ; Tralic et al., 2013 ) . Subsequent benchmarks further increased scale and manipulation diversity ( Mahfoudi et al., 2019 ; Kadam and others, 2021 ) , while recent work has increasingly addressed generative and instruction-driven editing ( Jia et al., 2023 ; Mareen et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Cai et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 早期的IFL基准侧重于拓扑,抄袭,以及有限的加工后文物(董等,2013年;许等,2006年;文等,2016年;关等,2019年). 后来的数据集拓宽了操纵源,并包括了更现实的无线图像(Novozamsky等人,2020年;Tralic等人,2013年)。 随后的基准进一步加大了规模和操纵多样性(Mahfoudi等人,2019年;Kadam等人,2021年),而最近的工作越来越多地涉及基因和教学驱动编辑(Jia等人,2023年;Mareen等人,2024年;Chen等人,2025年;Cai等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: IFL systems use constrained convolutions, noise or frequency cues, patch reasoning, transformer encoders, and segmentation decoders ( Bayar and Stamm, 2018 ; Wu and others, 2019 ; Chen et al., 2021 ; Hu et al., 2020 ; Wang et al., 2022 ; Ma et al., 2023 ) . More recent approaches use foundation-model representations and stronger multimodal or generative priors ( Guillaro et al., 2023 ; Su et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ; Ma et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: IFL系统使用受约束的演化,噪声或频率提示,补丁推理,变压器编码器,以及分区解码器(Bayar and Stamm,2018;Wu等人,2019;Chen等人,2021;Hu等人,2020;Wang等人,2022;Ma等人,2023). 较近期的办法采用基础模型表述和更强的多式联运或遗传学前科(Guillaro等人,2023年;Su等人,2025年;Zhu等人,2025年;Ma等人,2024年)。

blocks.en: Large self-supervised vision encoders provide semantically rich features for dense prediction. General segmentation systems have shown that transformer representations can support accurate masks when combined with task-specific decoders ( Kirillov et al., 2023 ; Ravi et al., 2025 ) . In image forensics, however, semantically invariant representations may suppress weak manipulation-specific evidence.
blocks.zh: 大型自我监督的视觉编码器为密集的预测提供了精密丰富的特征. 普通分解系统显示,变压器的表示方式与特定任务解码器结合时可以支持准确的口罩(Kirillov等人,2023年;Ravi等人,2025年)。 然而,在图像法证学中,刻板的无差异表述可能会压制薄弱的操纵特定证据.

blocks.en: 3 GIFTBench: Multi-Axis Benchmark for Generalization Diagnosis
blocks.zh: 3 GIFTBench:综合诊断的多轴基准

blocks.en: 3.1 Benchmark Design
blocks.zh: 3.1 基准设计

blocks.en: GIFTBench studies image forgery localization under benchmark-defined distribution shifts by annotating manipulation variation along four explicit dimensions and evaluating generalization separately with respect to each. Its design follows three principles: major sources of shift should be explicitly labeled rather than hidden within a random split; manipulation masks should have deterministic provenance; and the benchmark should support both axis-specific analysis and transfer to established external datasets.
blocks.zh: GIFTBench在基准定义的分布变化下研究图像伪造本地化,方法是按照四个明确维度对操纵变化进行注释,并分别对每个维度进行归纳评价. 其设计遵循三项原则:主要转移源应明确标注,而不是隐藏在随机分割内;操纵口罩应具有确定性来源;基准应支持对特定轴进行分析和向既定外部数据集转移.

blocks.en:
Accordingly, each manipulated image is characterized along four complementary axes: • Manipulation source: splicing, copy–move, removal, and AI editing; • Semantic target: object-, component-, and background-level manipulation; • Editing operation: adding, removing, and replacing content; • Composition complexity: single manipulation, fusion of multiple edits, and multi-source composition. Manipulation source describes the editing pipeline or generation family used to produce a sample, whereas editing operation describes the intended transformation applied to the image. The two annotations are distinct: Removal denotes a source-family pipeline, while Remove denotes an editing objective that may also be realized by other source families. Each sample retains both labels and can therefore be evaluated from either diagnostic perspective.
The first three axes characterize the origin, spatial semantics, and intent of an edit, while the composition axis captures the interaction of multiple manipulation processes or regions within the same image. Together, these factors define the benchmark’s multi-axis evaluation space.
blocks.zh:
因此,每个被操纵的图像都以四个互补轴为特征: 操纵源:成片,复制-移动,去除,和AI编辑; 语义目标:对象,组件,和背景层次的操纵; 编辑操作:添加,去除,和替换内容; 构成复杂:单一操纵,组合多个编辑,和多源构成. 操纵源描述了用于制作样本的编辑管道或生成家族,而编辑操作则描述了对图像的预期转换. 这两份说明是不同的:删除表示源家庭管道,而删除则表示其他源家庭也可能实现的编辑目标。 每个样本都保留标签,因此可以从两个诊断角度进行评估。
前三轴特征是编辑的起源,空间语义,以及意图,而组成轴则捕捉同一图像内多个操纵过程或区域的相互作用. 这些因素共同决定了基准的多轴评价空间。

blocks.zh: 操纵来源:复制、复制-移动、删除和大赦国际编辑;

blocks.en: Semantic target: object-, component-, and background-level manipulation;
blocks.zh: 语义目标:物体、组件和背景层面的操纵;

blocks.en: Editing operation: adding, removing, and replacing content;
blocks.zh: 编辑操作:添加、删除和替换内容;

blocks.en: GIFTBench uses ADE20K images and semantic annotations ( Zhou et al., 2019 ) to generate manipulations through vision–language-guided planning and multiple editing pipelines, while retaining explicit masks and provenance verified by automatic and manual quality checks. Before generation, all primary and donor sources are assigned to disjoint train or test pools, which are inherited by every generated sample and its source material. The benchmark contains 115,013 manipulated images, including 103,319 training and 11,694 test images; Fig. 2 summarizes the construction process, with full quality-control and release details provided in Appendix A .

blocks.en: 3.2 Evaluation Protocols
blocks.zh: 3.2 评价议定书

blocks.en: GIFTBench defines four axis-specific diagnostic protocols. Each organizes training and evaluation along one benchmark axis under common evaluation rules, without requiring the remaining annotations to be statistically matched. Results should therefore be interpreted as axis-associated transfer patterns rather than strict one-variable-at-a-time interventions.
blocks.zh: GIFTBench定义了四个轴特定诊断协议. 每项评价都根据共同评价规则,按照一个基准轴组织培训和评价,而不要求其余的说明在统计上相匹配。 因此,成果应被解释为轴向转移模式,而不是严格的一次性可变干预。

blocks.en:
• Protocol I: Manipulation-source transfer. Models are trained on one source and evaluated on four manipulation sources, yielding a 4 × 4 4\times 4 transfer matrix. • Protocol II: Semantic Target transfer. Models are trained and evaluated across three semantic target levels, yielding a 3 × 3 3\times 3 transfer matrix. • Protocol III: Editing-operation transfer. Models are trained and tested across three operations, yielding a 3 × 3 3\times 3 transfer matrix. • Protocol IV: Composition generalization. Models are trained on single-operation examples and evaluated on single, fusion, and multi-source manipulations to assess generalization to composed settings. In addition to the axis-specific protocols, we evaluate two forms of external transfer: released checkpoints are applied directly to GIFTBench without adaptation, while GIFTBench-trained models are evaluated on external datasets without target-domain fine-tuning. The former diagnoses the OOD transfer of existing systems, whereas the latter assesses generalization beyond the GIFTBench construction domain.
Pixel-level F1 and IoU are averaged over manipulated images, and cross-dataset results are macro-averaged over datasets. Real images are excluded from localization metrics; image-level detection is evaluated separately on datasets containing both real and manipulated images.
blocks.zh:
• 第一号议定书:操纵源转移。 对模型进行一个来源的培训,对四个操纵源进行评估,得出一个4×4 4\4的传输矩阵. • 第二号议定书:语义目标转让。 模型在三个语义目标级别上经过培训和评价,得出一个3×3 3\3的转录矩阵. • 第三号议定书:编辑业务转移。 模型经过三个操作的培训和测试,生成一个3×3 3\3的转录矩阵. • 《第四号议定书:组成概况》。 对模型进行单一操作实例培训,并对单一操作、聚变和多源操纵进行评估,以评估对组成环境的概括。 除了轴特定协议外,我们评价两种形式的外部转移:释放的检查站直接应用于GIFTBench,而GIFTBench训练的模型则在外部数据集上评价而不进行目标域微调. 前者分析现有系统的OOD转移,后者则评估超出GIFTBench构造域的通用化.
像素级的F1和IoU在被操纵的图像上平均,跨数据集结果在数据集上是宏观平均值. 真实的图像被排除在本地化的度量衡之外;图像级检测在包含真实的和被操纵的图像的数据集上分别评价.

blocks.en: 3.3 Benchmark Diagnosis
blocks.zh: 3.3 基准诊断

blocks.en: We analyze axis-specific failures by retraining representative CNN-, Transformer-, and foundation-model-based localizers with identical source-image splits, thresholds, and metrics. For released-checkpoint transfer, we use Protocol-MVSS and Protocol-CAT checkpoints from IMDL-BenCo ( Ma et al., 2024 ) and the MMTD-Set checkpoint from FakeShield ( Xu et al., 2025a ) . Transfer is markedly stronger on Splicing and Copy–Move than on Removal and AI–Edit. The same architecture behaves differently across training protocols, while model rankings vary among source and composition groups. Thus, OOD performance depends on both the training distribution and target condition and cannot be adequately characterized by a single aggregate score. Complete results are provided in Appendix Table 9 .
blocks.zh: 我们通过再培训具有代表性的CNN、变形金刚石和基于基础模型的本地化器来分析轴的失败, 在发放检查站时,我们使用IMDL-BenCo(Ma等人,2024年)的MMTD-Set检查站和假盾(徐等人,2025年a)的MMTD-Set检查站。 转帐比转帐和转帐要强得多。 同一架构在培训协议中的表现不同,而模式排名则因来源和组成组而异. 因此,OOD的成绩既取决于培训的分布,也取决于目标条件,不能以单一的总分为充分特征。 全部结果载于附录表9。

blocks.en:
Across the source, semantic-target, and operation protocols, transfer varies with the train–test pairing; Appendix Fig. 6 provides a compact visualization of these cross-domain asymmetries.
Figure 3 analyzes the failure mechanisms beyond aggregate scores. In panel (a), off-diagonal source transfers are dominated by false negatives while false positives remain low, and recall drops sharply relative to matched evaluation. Unfamiliar source traces are therefore chiefly missed rather than producing indiscriminate foreground predictions. Panel (b) shows that semantic-target groups also differ in their forensic statistics: background edits tend to occupy larger regions and exhibit weaker boundary gradients and lower high-frequency energy than object- and component-level edits. The semantic transfer gap thus coincides with changes in spatial extent, texture, and boundary strength rather than with category labels alone.

在整个源、语义目标以及操作协议中,转移随火车测试对等而异; 附录图6提供了这些跨域不对称的紧凑可视化。
图3分析了超过总分的失败机制. 在面板(a)中,非对角源转移以假负数为主,而假负数仍然很低,与匹配的评价相比,召回量急剧下降。 因此,人们主要忽略了不为人知的来源痕迹,而不是作出不分青红皂白的预测。 (b)小组显示,语义目标组在法证统计上也有所不同:背景编辑往往占据更大的区域,比对象和组件一级编辑显示的边界梯度更弱,高频能量更低。 因此,语义转移差距与空间范围、纹理和边界强度的变化相吻合,而不是仅仅与类别标签相吻合。

blocks.en: Panel (c) further reveals operation-dependent spatial failures. Add-trained models show relatively balanced boundary and core recall degradation, Remove-trained models lose more core recall, and Replace-trained models lose more boundary recall, indicating different reliance on interior and boundary evidence. Controlled single-to-composition evaluation also degrades across models (Appendix Table 13 ); panel (d) illustrates how co-occurring manipulations can redirect SparseViT attention from the original target toward competing visual regions, producing incomplete or expanded predictions. Together, these analyses show that generalization fails through distinct spatial mechanisms: missed unfamiliar cues, altered region statistics, boundary/interior sensitivity, and attention competition under composition.

blocks.en: 3.4 External Generalization of GIFTBench-trained Models
blocks.zh: 3.4 GIFTBench训练型号的外部通用

blocks.en: To assess generalization beyond GIFTBench, we evaluate representative localizers trained under GIFTBench and two established protocols on twelve external datasets. Table 2 reports pixel-level F1 across nine conventional IFL datasets and three related manipulation-localization datasets. GIFTBench training improves the aggregate external performance of all evaluated architectures relative to their corresponding reference training distributions. In particular, SparseViT trained on GIFTBench achieves the strongest Avg.-All F1 of 0.6029 among the evaluated benchmark-trained baselines. The gains are nevertheless target dependent, indicating that no single training distribution uniformly dominates across all external datasets.

blocks.en: 4 ForenScope: Benchmark-Informed Detection and Localization
blocks.zh: 4 ForenScope:基准成型检测和本地化

blocks.en: 4.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 4.1 概览

blocks.en: The GIFTBench diagnosis further indicates that manipulation evidence can be source sensitive, spatially heterogeneous under composition, and easily missed when local cues become ambiguous. These observations do not uniquely determine an architecture; instead, they suggest three design requirements: avoiding dependence on a single representation, modeling evidence across spatial extents, and allowing uncertain local predictions to exploit complementary image-level context. ForenScope instantiates these requirements as a joint detection–localization model with multi-depth layer–scale fusion, bounded CLS conditioning, and coarse-to-fine decoding.
blocks.zh: GIFTBench的诊断进一步表明,操纵证据可能是源的敏感,在组成下空间差异很大,当局部提示变得模糊时容易错过. 这些观测并不独具特色地决定了一种架构;相反,它们建议了三种设计要求:避免依赖单一的表示,跨空间范围建模证据,允许不确定的局部预测利用互补的图像级别背景. 福伦 范围即时将这些要求作为联合检测-局部化模型,具有多深层-规模聚变,有界CLS调节,以及粗细的解码。

Its CLS representation supports image-level detection, while intermediate patch representations retain spatial evidence for localization. The two tasks remain separately predicted, that allows the model to exploit task complementarity without making localization depend on a hard image-level decision.

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup

blocks.en: We evaluate ForenScope for image-level manipulation detection and pixel-level localization under two independently trained settings. The GIFTBench setting performs both training stages on the GIFTBench training split, whereas Protocol-MVSS repeats them using only CASIAv2; the settings share neither training data nor adapted checkpoints. All OOD datasets are reserved for evaluation, and checkpoints are selected using validation data from the corresponding training domain. Unless otherwise stated, ablations follow the GIFTBench setting.

blocks.en: 5.2 Overall Performance
blocks.zh: 5.2 总体业绩

blocks.en: Table 3 reports pixel-level F1 on three held-out GIFTBench composition subsets and nine OOD datasets; complete in-domain and twelve-dataset F1/IoU results are provided in Appendix E . On the source-disjoint GIFTBench split, ForenScope remains strong across source, semantic-target, operation, and composition views. Across the nine OOD datasets, the direct ForenScope output achieves the highest average F1 among the compared direct-output models and outperforms SparseViT on most datasets, despite dataset-specific variation.
blocks.zh: 表3报告了3个持有的GIFTBench组成子集和9个OOD数据集的像素级F1;附录E提供了完整的域内数据集F1/IoU结果。 在源与源不相连的GIFTBench拆分上,ForenScope在源,语义-目标,操作,和组成视图之间保持强势. 在9个OOD数据集中,ForenScope直接输出在比较的直接输出模型中实现了最高的平均F1,并在大多数数据集上超过了SparseViT,尽管数据集有特定的变异.

ForenScope achieves the highest average F1 among the compared methods, although its relative advantage varies across individual OOD datasets. The optional prototype refinement further improves the direct prediction and produces the strongest overall performance in this setting.
blocks.zh: 下级小组在《议定书》监测、监测和监视系统培训下报告交叉数据集结果。 福伦 范围在比较方法中达到最高的平均F1,尽管其相对优势因个人的OD数据集而异. 可选原型的改进进一步改善了直接预测,并产生了这种背景下最强的整体性能.

blocks.en: Although our architectural contributions focus on localization, ForenScope retains the image-level classifier inherited from the classification-adapted encoder. On the eight external datasets containing both real and manipulated images, the GIFTBench-adapted detector achieves an average ROC AUC of 0.935 and F1 of 0.871. The full per-dataset comparison, including the controlled CASIAv2-trained setting, is provided in Appendix E .
blocks.zh: 虽然我们的建筑贡献侧重于本地化,但ForenScope保留了从分类调整编码器中继承的图像级分类器. 在包含真实图像和被操纵图像的8个外部数据集上,GIFTBeench适应探测器平均实现ROC AUC0.935和F10.871. 附录E提供了每个数据集的全部比较,包括受控制的CASIav2训练设置。

blocks.en: Using only F17 causes the largest structural drop, supporting the aggregation of complementary evidence across encoder depths. The H37-only and H74-only variants perform comparably to each other but both underperform the full model, supporting the combination of spatial evidence across resolutions rather than reliance on a particular single scale. The w/o-ADE result supports classification-adapted representations, while removing CLS-FiLM has a smaller effect, suggesting a modest rather than uniform benefit from explicit conditioning. Prototype refinement improves the average without retraining; the equal-layer control and additional FiLM-off, shuffled-CLS, and joint-control diagnostics are reported in Appendix E.4 .
blocks.zh: 仅使用F17会导致最大的结构下降,支持跨编码器深度的补充证据的汇总. 仅H37和仅H74的变体相互具有类似的性能,但两者都使整个模型表现不佳,支持跨分辨率空间证据的结合,而不是依赖特定的单一尺度。 w/o-ADE结果支持分类调整的表示,而去掉CLS-FiLM的效果较小,说明明确条件的好处不大而非统一. 原型的改进在不进行再培训的情况下提高了平均值;附录E.4中报告了平层控制和额外的FiLM-off,shuffled-CLS,以及联控诊断.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented GIFTBench , a multi-axis benchmark for diagnosing image forgery localization generalization, together with ForenScope , a detection–localization model using learned depth–scale fusion and bounded global conditioning. GIFTBench exposes distinct transfer behavior across manipulation source, semantic target, operation, and composition while complementing controlled diagnosis with twelve-dataset external evaluation. ForenScope retains image-level detection and improves cross-dataset localization, demonstrating how structured benchmark diagnosis can provide testable guidance for more transferable forensic models.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了GIFTBench — — 诊断图像伪造局部化的多轴基准,以及ForenScope — — 一种利用学习到的深度、规模聚变和定界全球调节的探测本地化模型。 GIFTBench暴露了不同的转移行为,跨越了操纵源,语义目标,操作,和组成,同时以12个数据集的外部评价来补充控制诊断. 福伦 范围保留图像级检测,改进跨数据集本地化,表明结构化的基准诊断如何为更多可转移的法证模型提供可测试的指导.

blocks.en: Appendix A Benchmark Construction and Data Specification
blocks.zh: 附录A 基准构建和数据规格

blocks.en: This appendix section specifies what GIFTBench contains, how each manipulated sample is constructed, and how split membership, masks, and provenance are recorded. It supplements the benchmark overview in the main paper with the details needed to reconstruct protocol memberships without repeating the main motivation.
blocks.zh: 本附录一节具体说明GIFTBench包含哪些内容,每个被操纵的样本是如何构建的,以及如何记录分裂的会籍,面具和出处. 报告补充了主要文件中的基准概述,提供了重建议定书成员所需的细节,同时又不重复主要动机。

blocks.en: A.1 Scope, taxonomy, and task definition
blocks.zh: A.1 范围、分类和任务定义

blocks.en: GIFTBench is derived from ADE20K training images and their semantic annotations ( Zhou et al., 2019 ) . Its purpose is to keep the real-image universe and localization target controlled while exposing several sources of distribution shift that are usually entangled in existing IFL datasets. Each manipulated image has a split-assigned primary source image and, where applicable, split-assigned donor or component sources; it is also assigned metadata for manipulation source, semantic target, editing operation, composition level, split, construction configuration, and quality-control status. Multi-Source samples additionally retain component-level masks and provenance.
blocks.zh: GIFTBench来源于ADE20K训练画面及其语义说明(周 al等,2019). 其宗旨是控制真实图像宇宙和本地化目标,同时揭露通常缠绕在现有IFL数据集中的几种分布移源. 每个被操纵的图像都有一个被分割的原生图像,并酌情有被分割的捐赠者或组件源;它也被分配到元数据,用于操纵源,语义目标,编辑操作,组成级别,分裂,构造配置,以及质量控制状态. 多源样本还额外保留了组件级口罩和出处.

blocks.en: The four axes are defined as follows:
blocks.zh: 四轴的定义如下:

blocks.en: Table 5: The four diagnostic axes recorded by GIFTBench . A sample may participate in multiple protocol-specific groupings.
blocks.zh: 表5:GIFTBench记录的4个诊断轴 . 一个样本可能参加多个针对特定协议的分组.

blocks.en: These labels are intentionally not interchangeable. Removal in the source axis denotes a family of removal pipelines, whereas Remove in the operation axis denotes an editing objective that can also be instantiated by other source families. Similarly, Fusion and Multi-Source are composition levels derived from the same source-image universe, not independent image collections. This representation allows one sample to be grouped by different axes in different diagnostic protocols while keeping its image, mask, and provenance fixed.
blocks.zh: 这些标签有意不可互换。 源轴中的去除表示清除管道的家族,而操作轴中的去除则表示编辑目标,也可以被其它源家族即时化. 同样,Fusion和Multi-Source是来源于同一源图像宇宙的成分级,而不是独立的图像集. 这种表示方式使得一个样本可以在不同的诊断协议中用不同的轴进行组合,同时保持其图像,面具和出处的固定.

blocks.en: The released image-level label indicates whether an image is real or manipulated, while the pixel-level target is the binary mask of pixels changed by the recorded construction operation. Source-family, semantic-target, operation, and composition labels are metadata used to form controlled evaluation groups; they are not additional prediction targets in the localization experiments. The primary source identifier links an image and its mask, while donor and component provenance is retained when applicable; an image can therefore be assigned to different protocol views without changing its supervision.
blocks.zh: 已发布的图像级别标签表示一个图像是真实的还是被操纵的,而像素级别的目标则是被记录的构造操作改变的像素的二进制掩码. 源-家族,语义-目标,操作,和组成标签都是用来组成受控评价组的元数据;它们不是本地化实验中的额外预测目标. 主要源标识符将图像及其遮罩连接起来,而捐赠者和组件来源则在适用时保留;因此,图像可以被分配到不同的协议视图,而不改变其监督.

blocks.en: A.2 Construction pipeline
blocks.zh: A.2 建筑管道

blocks.en: The construction process begins with a real ADE20K image and its semantic annotations. Human experts define the taxonomy, admissible combinations, and construction constraints. A vision–language model then analyzes the scene and produces a structured manipulation plan, including the target region, source material from the assigned split, intended operation, and spatial attributes. A family-specific editing engine performs the pixel-level change, after which automatic checks, VLM-based verification, and manual review validate the image, mask, and metadata. Figure 2 summarizes this construction pipeline.
blocks.zh: 构建过程以真实的ADE20K图像及其语义说明开始. 人类专家界定了分类学、可接受组合和建筑限制。 一个视觉-语言模型然后分析场景并产生一个结构化的操纵计划,包括目标区域,来自指定分割的源材料,预期操作,以及空间属性. 一个针对家庭的编辑引擎执行像素级别变化,之后自动检查,基于VLM的校验,以及人工审查验证图像,面具,和元数据. 图2概述了这一施工管道。

blocks.en: The semantic taxonomy and admissible group assignments are fixed before generation. Candidate selection and editing use the recorded random state for the corresponding construction job, whereas mask derivation, normalization, quality checks, and split assignment are deterministic once the construction record is fixed. Geometric transforms are applied jointly to image and mask; photometric transforms are applied only to the image. Masks are resized with nearest-neighbor interpolation and re-binarized after every geometry-changing operation. These rules prevent augmentation from changing the localization target while preserving the intended appearance variation.
blocks.zh: 语义分类学和允许的组别分配在生成前是固定的. 候选人的选择和编辑使用记录的随机状态进行相应的施工工作,而口罩的生成、正常化、质量检查和分期分配则在施工记录确定后具有决定意义。 几何变换被联合应用于图像和面具;光度变换只应用于图像. 面具采用近邻内插法调整尺寸,每次几何变化操作后再进行复位. 这些规则防止增强在保留预期外观变异的同时改变本地化目标.

blocks.en: VLMs are used as semantic controllers rather than as the sole pixel generators. Qwen-VL and InternVL-family models ( Bai et al., 2025b ; Bai et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2025a ) identify eligible regions and contextual relations, propose or verify target regions and source materials, and assess placement, scale, occlusion, illumination, and scene compatibility where applicable. Candidate source contents are filtered for geometric completeness and contextual compatibility within the assigned split before execution. This separation lets the benchmark vary the editing engine without making the entire release an artifact of one VLM.
blocks.zh: VLM被用作语义控制器,而不是唯一的像素生成器. Quen-VL和InternVL-家庭模型(Bai等人,2025年b); Bai等人,2025a;Wang等人,2025a)确定合格区域和背景关系,提出或核实目标区域和源材料,并酌情评估位置、规模、隐蔽、照明和场景兼容性。 候选源内容在执行前在指定的拆分内过滤几何完整性和上下文兼容性. 这种分离让基准改变编辑引擎,而不会使整个发布成为一台VLM的文物.

blocks.en: Classical compositing, traditional or learned inpainting, and diffusion-based editors perform the actual image modification. The executor is selected according to the source family and the semantic characteristics of the target. A binary mask is generated from the recorded construction operation and identifies pixels changed relative to the original source. For composed samples, masks for the individual components are retained in addition to the final union or refined mask.
blocks.zh: 经典堆肥,传统或学习的涂装,以及基于传播的编辑器进行实际的图像修改. 执行器根据目标的来源家族和语义特征选择. 从所记录的构造操作中生成一个二进制掩码,并识别相对于原始源变化的像素. 对于构成的样品,除最终结合或精制的面具外,还保留单个部件的口罩。

blocks.en: A.3 Manipulation source instantiation
blocks.zh: A.3 操纵源即时处理

blocks.en: Splicing includes object insertion or replacement and background replacement. Background edits include partial-region, whole-region, and cross-class substitutions. For object edits, the structured plan specifies the candidate object, placement, support surface, scale, lighting relation, and occlusion constraints; compatible donor material is selected from the ADE20K pool assigned to the same train/test partition as the primary source before classical compositing executes the edit. These cases vary both local blending traces and scene-level consistency requirements.
blocks.zh: 扫描包括物体插入或替换以及背景替换. 背景编辑包括部分区域,全区域,以及跨类替代. 对于对象编辑,结构化计划指定了候选对象,位置,支持表面,尺度,照明关系,以及隐蔽限制;兼容的捐赠者材料从ADE20K池中选择,分配到相同的列车/测试分区,作为经典堆肥执行编辑前的主要来源. 这些案件既涉及当地混合痕迹,也涉及现场一致性要求。

blocks.en: Copy–Move includes background-to-background texture copying, background-to-object overwriting, whole-object relocation, superpixel-level cloning, texture extension, and the attribute subset. Candidate regions are selected according to semantic role and geometric completeness, followed by controlled transformations, color alignment, and blending. The attribute subset is categorized as Copy–Move in the release taxonomy and is included in the corresponding source-level counts.
blocks.zh: 复制 - 移动包括背景到背景纹理复制,背景到对象覆盖,整体对象迁移,超像素级克隆,纹理扩展,以及属性子集. 候选区域根据语义作用和几何完整性进行选择,然后是受控的转换,色调对齐,和混合. 属性子集被归类为Copy–move在发布分类中,并包含在相应的源级计数中.

blocks.en: Removal covers background-texture repair, structural-object removal, and semantic-foreground removal. The construction plan distinguishes locally repairable textures from extended structures and complete foreground instances. Traditional inpainting ( Telea, 2004 ) or learned inpainting ( Suvorov et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2022 ; Sargsyan et al., 2023 ; Jain et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2025 ) is selected according to the target’s spatial and semantic characteristics, so the source family is not restricted to one inpainting mechanism.
blocks.zh: 清除包括背景纹理修复、结构对象清除和语义前清除。 施工计划将当地可修复的纹理与扩展结构区分开来,并有完整的前景实例. 传统的涂装(Telea,2004年)或学会涂装(Suvorov等人,2022年;Li等人,2022年;Sargsyan等人,2023年;Jain等人,2023年;Li等人,2025年)是根据目标的空间和语义特征选择的,因此源系不局限于一种涂装机制.

blocks.en: AI-Edit samples use mask-conditioned diffusion editing driven by visually grounded, structured instructions. The plans cover subject-level, background/stuff-level, component-level, and spatial-interaction edits; each can implement Add, Remove, or Replace. Multiple diffusion and instruction-guided inpainting backends ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Podell et al., 2024 ; Manukyan et al., 2023 ; Zhuang et al., 2024 ; Batifol et al., 2025 ) are used to provide variation in generative mechanisms, while semantic target and operation remain separately recorded.
blocks.zh: AI-Edit样本使用基于视觉,结构化指令驱动的带口罩的传播编辑. 计划涵盖主题级别,背景/stuff级别,组件级别,以及空间交互编辑;每个计划可以执行添加,删除,或替换. 多种扩散与指导性涂装后端(Rombach等人,2022年;Podel等人,2024年;Manukyan等人,2023年;Zhuang等人,2024年;Batifol等人,2025年)用于提供基因机制的变异,而语义目标和操作则保持单独记录.

blocks.en: A.4 Composition construction
blocks.zh: A.4 组成结构

blocks.en: Composition is not treated as a fifth manipulation source. It tests whether evidence learned from isolated edits survives two controlled changes in the same source-image setting. Fusion begins with a single-operation manipulation and applies latent-diffusion inpainting ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Podell et al., 2024 ) only to a narrow morphological band around the existing manipulation boundary; pixels outside the band remain unchanged. The final mask includes the refined boundary band and the retained preceding manipulation, providing a matched single-operation reference.
blocks.zh: 组成不被视为第五个操纵源。 它测试从孤立编辑中吸取的证据是否在同一个源图像设定中两个可控变化中存活下来. Fusion从单操作操控开始,将潜扩散涂装(Rombach等人,2022年;Podell等人,2024年)只适用于围绕现有操控边界的狭长形态波段;波段以外的像素保持不变. 最终的面具包括精制的边界带和之前保留下来的操纵,提供了匹配的单操作参考.

blocks.en: Multi-Source composition combines two to four distinct single-manipulation components derived from the same real image and its assigned source pool. The visible components are placed back onto the original background with controlled spatial layouts, and their masks are merged into a final union mask. Component-level masks and provenance support analyses beyond the union-mask localization target. The composition training partitions are released for future composition-aware methods, whereas the Protocol IV baselines in this paper train only on GIFTBench-Core and therefore measure zero-composition generalization.
blocks.zh: 多源组成结合了从同一个真实图像及其指定源集合中衍生出来的两到四个不同的单调组件. 可见的组件以可控空间布局放回原背景,它们的口罩被合并为最终的联盟口罩. 除了工会任务本地化目标之外,还进行了组成部分一级的口罩和来源支持分析。 配料培训分区是用于未来配料意识方法的,而本文中的《议定书》第四号基线则仅在GIFTBench-Core上发布,因此衡量零配料一般化。

blocks.en: A.5 Quality assurance, masks, and provenance
blocks.zh: A.5 质量保证、口罩和出处

blocks.en: Before large-scale generation, each manipulation family and its mask-extraction procedure is checked on pilot examples for visual plausibility and mask correctness. During generation, samples whose manipulated region is below 0.5 % 0.5\% of the image area are discarded. Candidate samples are further filtered by geometry, manipulated-area, semantic consistency, visual quality, saliency change, and near-duplicate content. AI-Edit candidates additionally undergo BRISQUE no-reference quality assessment, used for relative ranking within each batch rather than with a fixed threshold, and CLIP-based semantic similarity between the edited region and the target instruction.
blocks.zh: 在大规模生成之前,每个操纵家族及其口罩提取程序都会被检查在可视性与口罩正确性的试点例子上. 在生成过程中,被操纵区域低于图像区域0.5% 0.5%的样本被丢弃。 候选样品通过几何,操纵区,语义一致性,视觉质量,显著变化,以及近重复的内容进一步过滤. 此外,AI-Edit候选人还接受BRISQUE无参考质量评估,用于在每个批次内相对排名,而不是固定门槛,基于CLIP的语义在编辑区域与目标指令之间相似.

blocks.en: All remaining samples receive VLM-based quality assessment. Classical manipulations use three-level scoring (1: superior, 2: acceptable, 3: discard), while AI-Edit samples receive type-specific binary verification of physical plausibility and image–instruction consistency. Samples with low saliency relative to the source, low visual quality, or duplicated scene content are removed. Finally, retained samples are manually inspected for incorrect edits, implausible results, and inaccurate masks. These checks prioritize reliable localization targets rather than only maximizing the number of generated images.
blocks.zh: 其余所有样本都得到基于VLM的质量评估。 古典操控使用三级评分(1:上等分,2:可接受分,3:丢弃分),而AI-Edit样本则获得特定类型二进制的物理可信度和图像–指令一致性验证. 相对于源头,视觉质量低,或者场景内容重复的样本被移除. 最后,对保留样品进行人工检查,以发现编辑不正确、结果不可信和面具不准确。 这些检查优先考虑可靠的本地化目标,而不是仅仅最大化生成的图像数量.

blocks.en: The released mask is a single-channel binary image with values 0 and 255. Construction-time grayscale masks are normalized at release time using threshold 128: values ≥ 128 \geq 128 are encoded as 255 and all other values as 0. Positive pixels denote changes relative to the original source under the recorded construction procedure. The construction pipeline initially produced 115,025 candidates; twelve Copy–Move training candidates with no positive pixels after normalization were excluded as invalid localization targets, yielding the final release of 115,013 samples. The excluded records are documented in the release audit and are not treated as a separate benchmark category.
blocks.zh: 释放的面具是一个单通道二进制图像,其值为0和255. 建造时的灰度口罩在发布时使用128阈值正常化: 128\geq 128值编码为255,所有其他值编码为0. 正像素表示在记录的构造程序下相对于原始源的变化. 建造管道最初产生了115 025名候选人;在正常化后没有正象素的十二名Copy-Move训练候选人被排除为无效的本地化目标,最终释放了115 013个样本。 不包括的记录在发行审计中记录,不作为单独的基准类别处理。

blocks.en: Each release record stores the manipulated-image identifier, original source identifier, mask, four-axis labels, split, construction engine and configuration identifier, and quality-control decision. For Multi-Source samples, component masks and component-level provenance are also retained. This record structure allows protocol memberships and dataset statistics to be regenerated from a common manifest.

blocks.en: For each manipulated image, the predicted probability map is thresholded at 0.5 and compared with the binary target mask. blocks.en: Appendix D ForenScope Architecture, Training, and Inference Details
blocks.zh: 附录D 论坛架构、培训和推论细节

blocks.en: D.1 Classification adaptation with LoRA
blocks.zh: D.1 与LORA的分类调整

blocks.en: Before localization training, DINOv2 is adapted together with a lightweight image-level classification head. The adaptation stage starts from the official DINOv2 ViT-L/14-reg pretrained weights and inserts LoRA adapters into the attention projections of blocks 8–23. The original encoder weights remain frozen; only the LoRA parameters and the CLS head are optimized with a binary classification loss. The head consumes the CLS token and predicts the real/manipulated image label. The LoRA adapters use a low-rank residual parameterization with a small update scale and dropout, while the classification head uses a larger learning rate than the adapters. Classification checkpoints are selected using the available classification validation protocol.
blocks.zh: 在本地化培训前,DINOv2与轻量级图像级分类头目一起进行改造. 适应阶段从官方的DINOv2 VIT-L/14-reg预训重量开始,并将LORA适配器插入8–23区块的注意力预测. 原始编码器重量仍为冻结;只有LORA参数和CLS头被优化为二进制分类损失. 头部会消耗CLS符号,并预测真实/操纵的图像标签. LORA适配器采用低等级的剩余参数化,更新尺度小,退出,而分类头则采用比适配器更大的学习率. 分级检查站采用现有分级审定规程选择.

blocks.en: We use two data configurations for this stage. The standard ForenScope configuration performs the adaptation on the ADE-domain classification data and provides the ADE-adapted encoder and CLS head used by the main localization model. The controlled Protocol-MVSS configuration repeats the same adaptation recipe from the official pretrained encoder on CASIAv2, using its real and manipulated images, and then initializes the subsequent localization stage from the resulting CASIAv2-adapted checkpoint. CASIAv1 is not used to optimize the CASIAv2 classification adaptation. These configurations change the source of the adapted representation, while the downstream localization architecture and the freezing rule remain the same.
blocks.zh: 这个阶段我们使用两个数据配置. ForenScope标准配置在ADE域分类数据上进行调适,并提供主本地化模型使用的ADE调整编码器和CLS头. 受控的MOP-MVSS配置重复了CASIAv2上官方预装编码器的相同适应配方,使用其真实的和被操纵的图像,然后从由此产生的CASIAv2调整后的检查站初始化之后的本地化阶段. CASIav1不用于优化CASIav2分类适应. 这些配置改变了改编代表的源头,而下游本地化架构和冻结规则保持不变.

blocks.en: After adaptation, the encoder, its LoRA parameters, and the CLS head are frozen during localization training. The localization decoder consumes patch features from the adapted encoder, while the frozen CLS representation is retained for image-level detection and for CLS-conditioned modulation of the localization branch. Thus, the classification adaptation is part of the initialization pipeline rather than an additional loss optimized during localization.
blocks.zh: 改造后,编码器,其LORA参数,以及CLS头在本地化训练中被冻结. 本地化解码器会从改编的编码器中消耗补丁特性,而冷冻的CLS代表则保留用于图像级检测和CLS有条件的本地化分支调制. 因此,分类适应是初始化管道的一部分,而不是本地化期间优化的额外损失。

blocks.en: D.2 Initialization and trainable modules
blocks.zh: D.2 初始化和可培训模块

blocks.en: ForenScope initializes its encoder and image-level branch from the ADE-domain classification-adapted DINOv2 model. During localization training, this encoder and the inherited classification branch remain frozen; only the localization-specific modules are optimized. The relevant structural variants and inference settings are summarized below without tying the paper to experiment-directory names or checkpoint hashes.

The classifier consumes the CLS token. The localization branch removes the first 1 + 4 1+4 tokens and reshapes only the remaining patch tokens into spatial maps. Feature taps are the zero-based DINOv2 block indices F ​ 8 , F ​ 11 , F ​ 14 , F ​ 17 F8,F11,F14,F17 ; register tokens are never treated as spatial patches.

blocks.en: The formal configuration uses three-process DDP with batch size 8 per process (global batch size 24), two data-loader workers per process, five epochs, learning rate 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} , and seed 42. Only the 3,210,256 localization-branch parameters are optimized. We use AdamW with weight decay 0.05, clip the decoder gradient norm at 1.0, linearly warm up for 500 optimizer steps, and then apply cosine decay to a learning-rate floor of 5 × 10 − 7 5\times 10^{-7} . blocks.en: The following tables separate independently retrained structural variants from fixed-checkpoint inference interventions. This distinction is essential: the structural table evaluates the final retrained Static LayerMixer model, whereas the diagnostic table changes only the prediction path of separately identified reference checkpoints. Thus, the diagnostic rows are not a second evaluation of the final ForenScope checkpoint. All structural rows use direct network outputs; the final inference row adds the prototype without retraining.
blocks.zh: 下表从固定检查点推论干预中分离出独立再培训的结构变体. 这种区分至关重要:结构表评价最后重新训练的静态层密歇根模型,而诊断表只改变单独确定的参考检查站的预测路径。 因此,诊断行并不是对ForenScope检查站的第二次评估。 所有结构行都使用直接的网络输出;最后的推论行添加原型而无需再培训.

blocks.en: The pure no-adaptation variant was evaluated on All-12 but not on the thirteen-group in-domain test, so its in-domain entry is left undefined. The structural rows show that ADE adaptation and multi-scale evidence improve transfer, whereas removing CLS-FiLM has a smaller effect after retraining. The joint control changes both encoder adaptation and conditioning and therefore does not isolate either factor.
blocks.zh: 纯无适应变体在All-12上被评价,但没有在十三组域内测试中被评价,因此其域内条目未定义. 结构行显示,ADE适应和多尺度证据可以改善转移,而去除CLS-FiLM在再培训后效果较小. 联合控制既改变了编码器的适应性,也改变了调节性,因此不会孤立两个因素。

blocks.zh: 表20:All-12上的固定检查点机制诊断。 平层控制使用最终的静层密歇根检查站;无CLS和全Late行使用各自的EMA检查站. 这些行都无法重覆网络

blocks.en: These fixed-checkpoint interventions test whether the corresponding trained prediction paths use learned fusion and CLS conditioning, rather than comparing independently retrained architectures. In particular, the Original Full-Late normal row (.643/.548) is a separate diagnostic reference and should not be compared as the Full baseline of Table 19 , whose final Static LayerMixer ForenScope row is .655/.556. A matched FiLM intervention on the final Static LayerMixer checkpoint would require a separate inference run. The optional prototype refinement is parameter-free and improves the external All-12 average, but its in-domain evaluation shows that the gain is not uniform across benchmark groups.
blocks.zh: 这些固定检查点干预测试了相应的训练有素的预测路径是否使用学到的聚变和CLS调节,而不是比较独立的再训练架构. 特别是,原始全Late正常行(643/548)是一个单独的诊断参考,不应与表19的全基线相比较,其最后的静态层Mixer ForenScope行为.655.556. FiLM在最后的Static LayerMixer检查站进行相应干预,需要单独进行推断。 可选原型的改进是无参数的,并改进了外部All-12的平均值,但其内域评价显示,各基准组的增益并不一致.
